title: Conditions signalled by nanowasm — nanowasm-conditions
text: Every error nanowasm raises class nanowasm_error, plus specific class code can catch tryCatch():

title: Conditions signalled by nanowasm — nanowasm-conditions
text: nanowasm_invalid_object: object longer points live module instance, example saveRDS() / readRDS() round trip. nanowasm_validation_error: bytes valid WebAssembly module. nanowasm_link_error: module instantiated imports given. missing field lists missing imports. nanowasm_argument_error: value passed R fit function's signature. subclass nanowasm_precision_error used i64 result represented exactly double. nanowasm_unsupported: function uses type nanowasm pass R WebAssembly (funcref, externref, v128). nanowasm_trap: WebAssembly code trapped. trap_id names trap ("div_by_zero", "unreachable", "out_of_bounds_memory_access", ...) detail holds interpreter's message. Subclasses: nanowasm_stack_exhausted (call value stack limit) nanowasm_out_of_bounds (memory table access bounds). nanowasm_memory_limit: interpreter allocate memory. nanowasm_runtime_error: failure inside interpreter.

title: Instantiate a module and call its functions — wasm_instantiate
text: wasm_instantiate() returns nanowasm_instance. wasm_call() returns function's results described .

title: Instantiate a module and call its functions — wasm_instantiate
text: Calls scalar: argument one value, matched function's parameter types. i32 accepts integer, double holding whole number \([-2^{31}, 2^{32})\); values \(2^{31}\) taken unsigned bit pattern. i32 results integers. NA_integer_ shares bits \(-2^{31}\), two value WebAssembly. i64 accepts whole number magnitude \(2^{53}\), i64 results doubles. result double represent exactly signals nanowasm_precision_error rather rounded. f32 f64 accept numbers, return doubles. function results returns NULL invisibly, one single result returns length-one vector, one several results returns unnamed list. WebAssembly code traps, call signals nanowasm_trap (see nanowasm-conditions). Calls limited 10,000 nested frames 1,000,000 value-stack cells, runaway recursion signals nanowasm_stack_exhausted error rather exhausting memory.
